title: ADALBERTI (colloquially)
Hle_beranek: Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sins of the world. — ECCE AGNUS DEI, QUI TOLLIT PECCATA MUNDI.
Mocne_zasahl: HE STRUCK HIM HARD WITH HIS ARM.
Snahy_o_zmenu: Efforts to reform the church are successful only if the reformers remain faithful to it. In the past, those who lost that faith went on to found new denominations. Today, they succumb to secularization. It is difficult to say whether it is worse to recruit followers for one's own deviation or to drown in the emptiness of individualism. What is the way out of this?
Kajicnosti: We all need repentance and faithfulness.
Kdo_zije: Those who live by the Gospel will learn to understand it. They will learn to love it. Those who are filled with joy in everything they are allowed to be will be able to act with ease and playfulness.
Po_tricet: For thirty years prior to the convening of the Council, Yves Congar was one of the key figures in the theological renewal of Catholicism in the 20th century. For decades, Rome viewed him with suspicion; ultimately, however, he lived to see the Second Vatican Council vindicate his ideas within the Church.
Az_udelate: When you have done all that has been commanded of you, say: 'We are merely unworthy servants; we have only done our duty.'
Tento_postoj: This attitude is characteristic of Congar's spirituality. He writes: "I have spent my entire life in the spirit of John the Baptist, the friend of the Bridegroom. I have always believed that one should not strive for anything, but be content with what has been given. For everyone, this is their 'logiké latreia,' a spiritual sacrifice, a personal path to sanctification. I therefore accepted what was given to me; I always tried to do well what was asked of me." When some bishops brought him the news that he was to be appointed a cardinal, he wrote: "I have never sought anything other than to be where God wants me to be, to serve Him." He adopted Pope John's motto: "Obedience and peace."
